beats.label: S1 · Rookie meets the underworld
beats.text: Rookie detective Jim Gordon takes the Wayne murders and is dragged into Gotham's mob war; ordered to execute the snitch Oswald Cobblepot, he fakes the kill instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pilot debt that binds Gordon and Cobblepot for the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · Cobblepot plays both sides
beats.text: Cobblepot returns to Gotham, worms into Don Maroni's crew, and secretly feeds Falcone intel — quietly playing both bosses against Fish Mooney's coup.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the schemer who will end the season as king of Gotham.

beats.label: S1 · Bruce starts digging
beats.text: Guarded by Alfred, 12-year-old Bruce begins investigating Wayne Enterprises' secret ties to organized crime, the thread he will pull on for years.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Launches Bruce's detective arc that anchors every season to come.

beats.label: S1 · Barbara breaks
beats.text: Barbara Kean's engagement to Gordon collapses under Cobblepot's shadow and her own addiction; she murders her parents and is committed to Arkham.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The point at which Gordon's ex becomes a Gotham villain in waiting.

beats.label: S1 · Nygma tastes murder
beats.text: Forensics tech Ed Nygma stabs Kristen Kringle's abusive boyfriend to death and hides the body, waking a gleeful second personality inside his head.
beats.whyLoadBearing: First real appearance of the Riddler that will drive later seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Penguin crowns himself
beats.text: Cobblepot engineers a full mob war, watches Mooney kill Maroni, throws Mooney off a rooftop, and declares himself Gotham's new crime lord as Falcone retires.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the underworld — the state of play as Season 2 opens.

beats.label: S1 · The hidden stairwell
beats.text: Tipped by junior Wayne Enterprises exec Lucius Fox, Bruce finds a hidden stairwell behind his father's fireplace — Thomas Wayne had a secret life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mystery box that pulls Bruce into every conspiracy that follows.

cliffhanger.text: Cobblepot has crowned himself king of Gotham's underworld. In the ruins of the mob war, Bruce is about to descend a hidden stairwell in his father's study, chasing a life Thomas Wayne kept from him.
questions: What did Thomas Wayne hide beneath Wayne Manor?
Can Cobblepot hold the throne now that Falcone has walked away?
What has Ed Nygma become after killing to keep his secret?

characters.name: Jim Gordon
characters.line: GCPD detective, back on the job after breaking Commissioner Loeb's blackmail, dating medical examiner Dr. Lee Thompkins.

characters.name: Harvey Bullock
characters.line: Gordon's cynical partner, off Fish Mooney's payroll and firmly on Gordon's side.

characters.name: Oswald Cobblepot / Penguin
characters.line: The snitch-turned-schemer who has just outlasted Falcone, Mooney and Maroni to claim Gotham's throne.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne
characters.line: 12-year-old orphan investigating his parents' killers and Wayne Enterprises' hidden crimes.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Bruce's guardian, now also training him to fight.

characters.name: Selina Kyle
characters.line: Teen street thief and the only living witness to the Wayne murders, drifting in and out of Wayne Manor.

characters.name: Barbara Kean
characters.line: Gordon's unstable ex-fiancée, freshly committed to Arkham after murdering her parents.

characters.name: Edward Nygma
characters.line: GCPD forensics tech hiding a homicidal second personality after killing Kristen Kringle's boyfriend.

beats.label: S2 · Galavan opens Arkham
beats.text: Cobblepot bullies Commissioner Loeb into resigning to reinstate Gordon; meanwhile Theo Galavan breaks Barbara, Jerome Valeska and other inmates out of Arkham as his Maniax.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's antagonist and the crew that will terrorise Gotham.

beats.label: S2 · Jerome burns bright, briefly
beats.text: The Maniax's public killing spree lets Galavan murder Jerome Valeska on live television, play the city's hero, and get himself elected mayor of Gotham.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jerome's early death and the icon it plants matter for the cult that comes later.

beats.label: S2 · Galavan kills Cobblepot's mother
beats.text: Galavan kidnaps Cobblepot's mother to leash him into wet work; when Cobblepot rebels, Galavan executes her, turning him into a vengeful wreck.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The wound that resets Cobblepot's motivation for the back half of the season.

beats.label: S2 · Nygma kills Kringle
beats.text: Nygma strangles Kristen Kringle to hide his prior murder, fully accepts his second personality, and is eventually caught and committed to Arkham.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Riddler is born and put on the shelf for Season 3 to open.

beats.label: S2 · Gordon and Cobblepot murder Galavan
beats.text: Galavan snatches Bruce for a ritual killing by the Order of St. Dumas; Gordon and Cobblepot rescue him and quietly execute Galavan on the docks.
beats.whyLoadBearing: A shared crime that Gordon and Cobblepot spend future seasons hiding.

beats.label: S2 · Indian Hill takes the body
beats.text: Wayne Enterprises quietly recovers Galavan's corpse for Prof. Hugo Strange, who is running illegal resurrection experiments beneath Arkham at Indian Hill.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Strange and Indian Hill — the pipeline that supplies Season 3's monsters.

beats.label: S2 · The monsters get loose
beats.text: Strange resurrects Fish Mooney and Galavan, is arrested, but a busload of his monsters escapes into Gotham — among them a boy identical to Bruce Wayne.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Every Season 3 threat walks off that bus.

cliffhanger.text: Hugo Strange is in FBI custody but his Indian Hill experiments — including a resurrected Fish Mooney and a boy who is Bruce Wayne's exact double — are loose in Gotham. Gordon leaves the badge behind to find Lee.
questions: Who is the boy wearing Bruce Wayne's face, and what does Strange want with him?
What will a resurrected Fish Mooney do with her strange new powers?
Can Gordon find Lee and win her back after losing their child?

characters.name: Jim Gordon
characters.line: Cleared of Galavan's murder but off the force, heading out of town to find Lee.

characters.name: Harvey Bullock
characters.line: Acting captain of the GCPD while Barnes recovers.

characters.name: Oswald Cobblepot / Penguin
characters.line: Declared sane and released from Arkham, broken by his mother's execution.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne
characters.line: Knows Wayne Enterprises' own board hired his parents' killer; has run to the streets with Selina to learn how to fight.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Bruce's guardian, allied with junior Wayne exec Lucius Fox in the hunt.

characters.name: Selina Kyle
characters.line: Living rough alongside Bruce.

characters.name: Edward Nygma / Riddler
characters.line: Kringle's killer, an inmate of Arkham.

characters.name: Barbara Kean
characters.line: Awake from her Arkham coma, sane on paper, released back into the city.

characters.name: Fish Mooney
characters.line: Resurrected by Prof. Hugo Strange with mind-control powers, loose in Gotham with his other escaped monsters.

characters.name: Subject 514A ('Five')
characters.line: A boy physically identical to Bruce Wayne, released among Strange's escapees.

beats.label: S3 · The city of monsters
beats.text: Six months on, Gordon works as a bounty hunter tracking Indian Hill's escapees while a resurrected Fish Mooney rebuilds her gang using her new mind-control powers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the post-monster Gotham the whole season is untangling.

beats.label: S3 · Mayor Penguin, Chief-of-Staff Nygma
beats.text: Cobblepot wins the mayor's race, springs Nygma from Arkham as his chief of staff, and quietly falls in love with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The alliance whose collapse is the season's engine.

beats.label: S3 · The Tetch virus
beats.text: Jervis Tetch's poisoned blood infects Captain Barnes with a virus that drives its victims into homicidal rage — the season's ticking bomb.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The weapon the season's real villains will eventually unleash on Gotham.

beats.label: S3 · Nygma shoots Cobblepot
beats.text: When Nygma finds love with a woman called Isabella, Cobblepot has her killed to keep him close; Nygma pieces it together and shoots Cobblepot into Gotham Harbor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The break that turns Cobblepot and Nygma into permanent enemies.

beats.label: S3 · The Court of Owls
beats.text: Bruce uncovers the Court of Owls — the cabal that ordered his parents' murder — and Gordon infiltrates them through his late father's old ties to the group.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Court is the shadow answer to every mystery Bruce has been chasing.

beats.label: S3 · The Shaman and Ra's
beats.text: A mysterious Shaman breaks and rebuilds Bruce to serve his true master: the immortal warlord Ra's al Ghul, who wants Bruce as his heir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the man who will drive Season 4's endgame.

beats.label: S3 · Virus night, mask born
beats.text: The Court unleashes Tetch's virus on Gotham; a night of citywide madness is undone by an antidote, and Bruce takes up a mask as the city's vigilante.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bruce becomes an active vigilante — the identity Season 4 builds around.

cliffhanger.text: Bruce has taken up a mask to fight for Gotham, and Ra's al Ghul is alive and watching him. Cobblepot has Ed Nygma frozen and displayed as a trophy inside his new Iceberg Lounge.
questions: What does Ra's al Ghul want from Bruce now that the Court is broken?
How long before someone thaws Nygma out of Cobblepot's ice?
Who really runs Gotham's underworld with Cobblepot and Nygma both toppled?

characters.name: Jim Gordon
characters.line: Back on the GCPD after surviving the Tetch virus; Lee has left him.

characters.name: Harvey Bullock
characters.line: Still Gordon's partner at the precinct.

characters.name: Oswald Cobblepot / Penguin
characters.line: Deposed as mayor, running the new Iceberg Lounge, out for Nygma's blood.

characters.name: Edward Nygma / Riddler
characters.line: Broke free of Cobblepot, then frozen and displayed as a trophy inside the Lounge.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne
characters.line: 14, newly masked, patrolling Gotham as its self-appointed vigilante.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Recovered from being run through by a brainwashed Bruce, back at his side.

characters.name: Selina Kyle
characters.line: Training with Tabitha Galavan and learning to fight with a whip.

characters.name: Tabitha Galavan
characters.line: Theo's sister; electrocuted Barbara Kean to death and is now mentoring Selina.

characters.name: Butch Gilzean
characters.line: Shot in the head by Barbara, comatose in hospital; records reveal his birth name is Cyrus Gold.

characters.name: Ra's al Ghul
characters.line: Immortal head of the League of Shadows, sees Bruce as his heir, still very much alive.

beats.label: S4 · Licenses of Misconduct
beats.text: Cobblepot rules Gotham through 'Licenses of Misconduct' that legalise crime for his loyalists; Bruce dons a prototype suit and begins fighting back as a vigilante.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the rule Cobblepot must lose and the vigilante whose choices drive the season.

beats.label: S4 · Bruce ends Ra's, briefly
beats.text: Ra's al Ghul comes to Gotham for a knife that can end his immortality; Bruce stabs him and he crumbles, but Ra's has already made Barbara his heir.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ra's death gives Barbara a mystical inheritance that carries the season.

beats.label: S4 · Butch becomes Grundy
beats.text: Cobblepot dumps Butch's body into Indian Hill chemicals; he rises again as Solomon Grundy — super-strong, memory-wiped, and eventually paired with Nygma.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grundy is the muscle at the centre of the season's underworld ecosystem.

beats.label: S4 · Sofia plays everyone
beats.text: Carmine Falcone's daughter Sofia arrives, plays Cobblepot as a friend and Gordon as a lover, and quietly maneuvers Gordon into the Captain's chair.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sofia's slow con is the spine of the middle stretch of the season.

beats.label: S4 · The Mario trap closes
beats.text: Sofia's true endgame is revenge for her brother Mario — she topples Cobblepot into Arkham to leave Gordon carrying the guilt for the rest of his career.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reveal that reframes everything Gordon and Cobblepot have done all season.

beats.label: S4 · Enter Jeremiah Valeska
beats.text: Jerome Valeska returns, terrorises Gotham, and dies revealing an estranged twin, Jeremiah; his final act doses Jeremiah with fear toxin, birthing a colder maniac.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the archnemesis who defines what remains of the show.

beats.label: S4 · The bridges fall
beats.text: Jeremiah bombs every bridge out of Gotham; the government seals the city off, Ra's is briefly resurrected and killed again by Barbara, and Selina is left paralysed by a bullet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Gotham into the No Man's Land Season 5 opens inside.

cliffhanger.text: Jeremiah's bombs have cut Gotham off from the mainland and reduced it to lawless boroughs. Bruce accepts his destiny as the city's protector; Gordon lights a searchlight over GCPD Headquarters as a beacon in the dark.
questions: Can Gordon and Bruce hold Gotham together while the underworld carves it up?
What has Hugo Strange 'fixed' in the near-corpses of Nygma and Lee?
Where has Jeremiah Valeska gone now that he has broken the city?

characters.name: Jim Gordon
characters.line: Captain of the GCPD, staying inside sealed-off Gotham with a small band of officers.

characters.name: Harvey Bullock
characters.line: Back at Gordon's side after his own crisis.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne
characters.line: Teenaged, masked, sworn as Gotham's protector.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Still at Wayne Manor with Bruce.

characters.name: Selina Kyle
characters.line: Paralysed by a bullet from Jeremiah Valeska, hospital-bound as the bombs go off.

characters.name: Oswald Cobblepot / Penguin
characters.line: Dethroned by Sofia, betrayed and jailed, now scheming from the shadows with Hugo Strange as an asset.

characters.name: Edward Nygma
characters.line: Stabbed near-dead by Lee; his body handed to Strange to 'fix'.

characters.name: Leslie Thompkins
characters.line: Stabbed near-dead by Nygma; her body handed to Strange to 'fix'.

characters.name: Barbara Kean
characters.line: Ra's al Ghul's chosen heir — she killed him with his own knife; still running a crew with Tabitha Galavan.

characters.name: Jeremiah Valeska
characters.line: Insane new archnemesis who bombed the bridges and vanished as Gotham fell.

beats.label: S5 · No Man's Land
beats.text: With Gotham cut off from the mainland, Gordon runs the GCPD as a refugee shelter while gang lords carve up the boroughs; Bruce and Alfred fight beside him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The setting the whole season plays out inside.

beats.label: S5 · Ivy's seed saves Selina
beats.text: Ivy — now a full plant-witch running the city park — trades a seed to save the paralysed Selina, who walks again with cat-like qualities.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Selina back on her feet in the form she keeps for the series' end.

beats.label: S5 · Haven burns
beats.text: A rebuilt safe zone called Haven is bombed and hundreds die; the bomber turns out to be a mind-controlled Nygma with a chip lodged in his brain.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The atrocity that reveals a hidden hand pulling the strings of the season.

beats.label: S5 · Bane and Nyssa revealed
beats.text: The chip's puppeteer is Eduardo Dorrance, a soldier turned into venom-boosted Bane by 'Theresa Walker' — Ra's al Ghul's daughter Nyssa, out to punish Gordon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the season's real antagonists and their motive.

beats.label: S5 · Jeremiah into the vat
beats.text: Jeremiah restages the Wayne murders to bond Bruce to him, then falls into a chemical vat — disfigured and brain-dead; Barbara reveals she is carrying Gordon's child.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Jeremiah into the state a returning Bruce will eventually meet, and seeds Gordon's daughter.

beats.label: S5 · Reunification
beats.text: Nyssa's Bane-led military assault is broken by Gotham; reunification goes ahead, Gordon is named Commissioner, and Bruce leaves the city to travel the world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The reset that lets the finale jump forward ten years.

beats.label: S5 · Bat and signal
beats.text: Ten years on, Bruce returns as a masked bat-vigilante; Gordon lights a bat-shaped signal over the GCPD and calls him in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The endpoint the whole series has been walking toward.

cliffhanger.text: Ten years after No Man's Land, Bruce is back as a bat-masked vigilante and Gordon calls him in with a signal in the night sky. Cobblepot and Nygma have escaped custody again, and Jeremiah is loose after faking his brain-death.
questions: Can the vigilante and the Commissioner keep pace with Cobblepot and Nygma's next play?
What did Bruce do during his ten years away that made him this?
Is Jeremiah truly the Joker the city has been waiting for?

characters.name: Jim Gordon
characters.line: GCPD Commissioner, ten years in, father to Barbara Lee, calling in a masked bat as an ally.

characters.name: Bruce Wayne
characters.line: 24, back from a decade abroad as Gotham's caped bat-vigilante.

characters.name: Selina Kyle
characters.line: Cat-themed burglar, reunited with Bruce.

characters.name: Alfred Pennyworth
characters.line: Still at Bruce's side after the decade away.

characters.name: Harvey Bullock
characters.line: A decade older and still standing beside Gordon at GCPD.

characters.name: Oswald Cobblepot / Penguin
characters.line: Just released from Blackgate after a decade in custody, immediately back to plotting.

characters.name: Edward Nygma / Riddler
characters.line: Broken out of Arkham and teamed back up with Cobblepot.

characters.name: Barbara Kean
characters.line: Mother of Gordon's daughter Barbara Lee, gone mostly straight.

characters.name: Jeremiah Valeska
characters.line: Faked brain-death for a decade; now loose again, hunting the man in the mask.
